title: Introduction to custom widgets
body: In the previous doc, we had a section dedicated to custom widgets. It was very minimal but it was there. Now we don't have the necessary key elements for the creation of new custom widgets.

comments.body: This has been shipped with v2.1.0, you can find the guide [here](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/custom-widget.html)
